# Data Placeholder

This folder intentionally does not include the large generated COPD custom-KG JSON assets from the local research environment.

In the original workspace, `dashboard_case_app.py` referenced:

- `data/copd_custom_kg/copd_chronic_custom_kg.json`
- `data/copd_custom_kg/copd_ae_custom_kg.json`
- `data/copd_custom_kg/copd_infection_custom_kg.json`

These files were generated retrieval assets, not source code, and were omitted from this GitHub export to keep the release focused on program code.
